node.title: Re: Problem upgrading XML::Fast from 0.11 to 0.17
node.author: ablanke
node.doctext:
Hi mje,

maybe [href://https://metacpan.org/diff/file?target=MONS%2FXML-Fast-0.17%2F&source=MONS%2FXML-Fast-0.11|this diff] is helpful.

there is a change in the xs file:

-SV* -_xml2hash(xml,conf) - char *xml; +void +_xml2hash(xml_sv,conf) + SV *xml_sv; HV *conf; PROTOTYPE: $$ - CODE: + PPCODE: + SvGETMAGIC(xml_sv); + char *xml = SvPVbyte_nolen(xml_sv);

after all without adding the utf8decode option xml2hash marks your hash value as [metamod://utf8].
